item.title: Small Space Home Gym: What to Buy First, in the Right Order
item.description: Building a small space home gym? Start with a mat, then bands, then adjustable dumbbells, and add a kettlebell or bench only when you are ready. A simple buying order for apartments, with what to look for. Guide contains affiliate links.
